ctx.x: Iceland, we played two or three days there and this time I think I better cut out because this is a little bit too much for me. So I had my notice in to Louie and from there we went to back to New York and we only had a few hours and we have to get warm clothes, "Where we going?" We're going to St. Thomas, Virgin Islands and St. Croix, Virgin Islands. Then from there, we went from Virgin Islands to Puerto Rico, San Juan. And then from Puerto Rico we went to Miami. Then from Miami begin the southern tours and I…

And you know, the story goes now, Billy Kyle rehearses the band, you know, and the background that I do with Louie, Billy Kyle is trying to tell Glenn, Tyree Glenn how to play that and I understand they had a few words together and I don't blame Tyree Glenn, he kind of got peeved at Billy because Billy wanted Tyree to play the same background that I played
